title: Lakhpat Rai Swears to Destroy or Convert the Khalsa

blocks.text: This page acts as a hinge between episodes. After Jaspat's death the Singhs were no longer destitute, because the plunder of Imnabad had given them money, grain, and breathing room, but the narrative immediately turns to a larger and darker retaliation.

A new heading shifts the scene to Parol, Kathuha, and Basohli in the Jammu region, opening the Chhota Ghallughara sequence. Lakhpat Rai laid his turban at the Nawab's feet and turned private grief into a public vow of vengeance for his slain brother.

He declared that he would not retie that turban until the Khalsa had been either annihilated or driven into apostasy. With the Nawab's blessing, funding, and armed backing, he vowed to destroy or convert the Khalsa and began organizing the campaign that would soon engulf the countryside.
